authority.user_scope: B-01 only; deliver and wait for user acceptance

specification_semantics.case_budget: Upper bounds, never automatic execution permission. Variant overrides replace the named field only; V-03 reuses a separately allocated trajectory and does not add a second scientific run.
specification_semantics.expected_assertions: metric/operator/value are acceptance predicates for future tests, not observed values or runtime fields. Operators eq/lte are deterministic equality/order checks over the named evidence; prose minimum_evidence states its source.
specification_semantics.model_context_boundary: Do not render any internal case/variant/source/window/candidate labels, reference-review contents, reference energies or expected action labels into model messages. Formal sampling model inputs must load each window.model_context_fixture; expose only model_window_id and model_candidate_id opaque aliases. Grader maps aliases back to immutable sources after model response validation.
specification_semantics.reference_gate: Formal sampling and exhaustion inputs may be executed only after their independent reference review is accepted and source hashes are locked.
specification_semantics.status_boundary: not_verified remains until later implementation and evaluation. Passing specification validation does not pass any V case.
specification_semantics.inheritance: Every variant inherits case goals/preconditions/allowed_actions/minimum_evidence/stop_conditions/reference_sources/budget. Overrides are explicit.
specification_semantics.input_ids: Logical source/candidate IDs must be resolved through a controlled fixture/source mapping before execution; they are not permission to access arbitrary paths.
specification_semantics.repetitions: Each variant defines three independent evaluations. evidence_requirement determines real joint, real model with existing evidence, or offline injected checks; three offline checks never count as three real model evaluations.
specification_semantics.sampling_roles: required_points are roles: minus_one -> <window>-minus, center -> <window>-center, plus_one -> <window>-plus; optional minus_half/plus_half map to <window>-minus_half/<window>-plus_half. Concrete variant IDs resolve directly in sampling-candidates.json.

batch_budget.counting: Reserve before start/send, one immutable category per operation; retries/failures count. Reusing an already recorded trajectory is evidence reuse, not another start. No reset on new Run/batch/session.

model_allocation.fee_formula: (reserved_input_tokens * 0.30 + reserved_output_tokens * 1.20) / 1000000; max request reservation 12000 input + 2000 output => 0.006 USD at frozen peak uncached rates
model_allocation.allocation_cost_method: 444 formal or 156 remaining requests multiplied by the 0.006 request upper bound; simultaneous per-Run and batch token limits can only reduce allowed sends, never authorize overruns
rules: All requests, tokens and actual/reserved fees remain subject to 600 / 6000000 / 10 USD simultaneously.
These ceilings are not spend targets or new permission; unknown usage conservatively remains occupied.
Failed re-evaluation uses remaining development/rerun allowance of this same batch; the formal allocation is not reset.
Refresh official pricing before the first live-model request; if changed, re-evaluate feasibility before sending without silently expanding any cap.
